author: Cindi Gardner
text:
Drew did an amazing job on 2 jobs for me.
Not only was he efficient and timely, his clean up was fabulous. One huge tree went down and he cleaned up every leaf. He takes great pride in his work and I would highly recommend him.

author: Mike Jones
text: Drew is a stand-up guy with a strong work ethic. We had an issue with our septic system and he came out and fixed it in short order at a very reasonable price.   I highly recommend KD Services  !!!

author: Bill Gann
text: Excellent work done in a timely manner... Very satisfied. Picture after grass grew back in. Again awesome job!!!

text: Highly recommend K&D Services, they dug and placed my Septic tank  at a new build., they were quick and efficient. Hired them again for grading and back fill, very pleased with Drew’s work.

text: I think  Drew done work for me for 4 or 5 years! Done an absolutely great job and I would highly recommend kD Services Excavation & Septic! Great and honest guy!
